# Security Policy

**PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY, [SEE BELOW](#reporting-a-vulnerability).**

## Supported Versions

Laravel Rust hasn't been released yet. Security fixes are made on the `main` branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Laravel Rust, please report it privately using the **Report a vulnerability** button on this repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/portside-labs/laravel-rust/security). Please don't open a public issue or pull request. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.

Vulnerabilities in Laravel itself should be reported to Laravel, as described in [Laravel's security policy](https://github.com/laravel/framework/security/policy).
